extension_description.message: See and manage the tabs and bookmarks of all your browsers in one place.

sidebar_resize.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider between the sidebar and the list.

empty_body.message: Open a tab in this browser, or sign in on another one, and it will show up here.

no_results.message: No tabs or bookmarks match your search.

banner_auth.message: This hub refused this browser’s key. Pair it again to keep syncing.

banner_quota.message: Your hub has used its daily write allowance. Syncing resumes tomorrow.

banner_incompatible.message: The extension and the hub speak different versions. Update one of them.

onboarding_body.message: Roost stores your tabs on infrastructure you own. Deploy a hub to your Cloudflare account, then tell this browser where it is.

onboarding_step_deploy_body.message: Copy this key, then open the deploy page and paste it in when Cloudflare asks for PAIRING_SECRET. Already have a hub? Paste its key here instead.

onboarding_found.message: A Worker is open in another tab. If this is the hub you just deployed, connect to it:

onboarding_url_warning.message: What changes if this address changes

onboarding_url_warning_data.message: The old hub stays on your account and keeps every tab and bookmark it holds. A new address is a new, empty hub; nothing is moved across.

onboarding_url_warning_devices.message: Your other browsers still point at the old address, so they stop seeing this one until each is paired again.

onboarding_url_warning_permission.message: The permission you granted for the old address stays granted, and the new one has to be granted separately.

onboarding_url_warning_rename.message: Renaming the Worker on the Cloudflare deploy screen does all of this too, because the name is what the address is made of.

onboarding_sync_label.message: Use this hub in my other Chrome browsers

onboarding_sync_note.message: Chrome carries the address and the key to browsers signed in to the same Google account, so they pair without typing. The key travels through that account.

onboarding_error_url.message: Enter an https address, for example https://sync.example.com

onboarding_error_wrong_key.message: That address answered, but refused this key.

restore_body.message: $count$ tabs will open in a new window. Only the first one loads; the rest wait until you look at them.
